items.example: I think it's a good idea.
items.simple: You say what is in your head about something.

items.example: I reckon it'll rain later.
items.simple: Another way to say what you think. People say it a lot when they talk.
items.note: Günlük, İngiliz konuşma dili; "I think" yerine.

items.example: If you ask me, this film is boring.
items.simple: You tell what you think, because someone wants to know.

items.example: To be honest, I didn't like it.
items.simple: You say this before you tell the true thing.

items.example: I totally agree. You're right.
items.simple: You think the same as the other person. All the way.

items.example: I don't think so. It's too far.
items.simple: A soft way to say no.

items.example: What's your opinion about the new teacher?
items.simple: What you think about something.

items.example: Obviously, I want to win.
items.simple: Everyone can see it. It is very easy to see.

items.example: Honestly, I don't mind.
items.simple: You are saying the true thing, with no lie.

items.example: That's a good point. I hadn't thought of that.
items.simple: You say this when the other person said something clever.

items.example: I see what you mean, but I disagree.
items.exampleTr: Ne demek istediğini anlıyorum ama katılmıyorum.
items.simple: You understand the other person, but maybe you think different.

items.example: I'm not so sure about that.
items.simple: You do not really believe it. You have doubts.

items.example: Fair enough. Let's do it your way.
items.simple: You say okay, because what they said makes sense.

items.example: In my opinion, it's too expensive.
items.simple: You tell that this is what you think, not what everyone thinks.

items.example: I'd rather stay home than go out.
items.exampleTr: Dışarı çıkmaktansa evde kalmayı tercih ederim.
items.simple: You like one thing more than the other thing.

items.example: I agree with you.
items.simple: You think the same as someone else.

items.example: I'm sorry, but I disagree.
items.simple: You think something different from someone else.

items.example: You have a point there.
items.simple: What you said is true or clever.

items.example: Have you made up your mind yet?
items.simple: You pick one thing after you thought for a long time.

items.example: He comes across as really friendly.
items.simple: This is how people see you when they meet you.

items.example: We agreed on a price.
items.simple: Everyone says yes to the same thing.

items.example: It seems to me that he's tired.
items.exampleTr: Bana öyle geliyor ki o yorgun.
items.simple: This is what you see and feel is true.

items.example: Either way, I'm happy.
items.simple: It does not matter which one you pick.
